bug_semantics: The hermit manager interpolates attacker-controlled package identity (depName plus version/newValue) into a single shell string `./hermit install ${toPackage}` (and later `./hermit uninstall ...`) and passes that string to Renovate's exec() helper, which is promisified child_process.exec and therefore always runs under a shell. Because the tokens are not shlex-quoted, a repository writer can plant a malicious hermit dependency name containing shell metacharacters (advisory PoC: a bin/.|| kill 1 ||@0.0.1.pkg symlink) so that artifact update executes arbitrary commands on the machine running Renovate. Vendor range is npm renovate >=32.135.0 <40.33.0.
flaw_origin: The unsanitized interpolation was first written when Yun Lai added Hermit support: getHermitPackage() returns `${name}-${version}` and updateHermitPackage() builds `const execCommands = `./hermit install ${toPackage}`` in lib/modules/manager/hermit/artifacts.ts with no quote()/escaping. That blob was authored in closed combined PR #16250 (b96f4e3), copied identically into split PR #16258 (ab6b928), and squash-landed as 32.135.0 (b696abb). Later eaec10d quoted only the unused fromPackages error string, and 41e8b99 copied the same unquoted join into uninstall; neither changed the install sink. Human BIC, no commit-object AI markers.
